first.text:
Lyra sits a little away from the campfire. Several books float in front of her.

"If you're about to interrupt me to ask what I'm reading: no."

She turns a page.

"You wouldn't understand it anyway."

"An unexpected decision."

"But I won't stop you."

"You recruited me of your own free will."
